about: MPAS suite selections that run upstream code under terms that do not permit an Apache-2.0 distribution that may be sold. gpuwm-hex is Apache-2.0 and its public distribution carries only permissive third-party code (BSD, MIT, Apache-2.0, public domain) and US Government code. A selection listed here runs code under restricted terms (UCAR's Noah-MP terms forbid sale). No default route selects one (owner ruling 2026-10-14: the package stays Apache-2.0 and no default routes into code that cannot be sold or is limited). The forecast door refuses a run that selects one unless the run opts in by naming the terms: --licence-opt-in ID or GPUWM_HEX_LICENCE_OPT_IN=ID. With the opt-in the run prints a LICENCE line per selection and records licence_opt_in in its physics receipt. Read by hexcore.licence_gate; the hex ports of these components are withheld from the public export by tools/licence_holds.json. not_gated records upstreams a ruling took out of the gate, and retired_terms the opt-in names that no longer gate anything: a run that still names one is told so on stderr and runs as it would without it.

ucar-noahmp.name: UCAR Noah-MP terms
ucar-noahmp.clause: You shall not sell, license or transfer for a fee the Software, or any work that in any manner contains the Software.
ucar-noahmp.evidence: physics_noahmp/LICENSE.txt, sha256 bd58c64131e08711ea7eb436f7a9520187626e6dcd0550fd6947f3060697d212, byte-identical in MPAS-Model v8.4.2 (f34984b2c89353cf31c235b08d3b4acd96b37bb3) and in the RRFSx fork (1d6e370e7b43a332074809f170532a216c2212fb)

noahmp-v5-mpas.what: Noah-MP v5.0 (NCAR community Noah-MP) as MPAS-Model v8.4.2 carries it in src/core_atmosphere/physics/physics_noahmp
noahmp-v5-mpas.upstream: https://github.com/NCAR/noahmp, carried in MPAS-Model v8.4.2 f34984b2c89353cf31c235b08d3b4acd96b37bb3
noahmp-v5-mpas.alternative: hex's permissive Noah-MP is the WRF-lineage v4.x (WRF 4.6.1's Noah-MP, NCAR/noahmp 848f54ad3d28c4303151fe5ad83724e232694422, which carries no licence file and ships under WRF's public-domain notice) on the ArWen suite, the default route: run without --physics-suite and without the namelist's config_physics_suite. Noah-MP v5.0 is a refactoring 'without physics changes' (its release notes), but the v4.x run is not MPAS-bitwise. On the MPAS suite, config_lsm_scheme='sf_noah' (Noah, WRF public-domain notice) is the suites' own default.

noahmp-v5-rrfs.what: Noah-MP v5.0 as the RRFSx MPAS-Model fork carries it in src/core_atmosphere/physics/physics_noahmp
noahmp-v5-rrfs.alternative: the RRFS stage's own land surface (sf_ruc) or sf_noah; the ArWen suite's Noah-MP v4.x (WRF public-domain notice) on the default route

ugwp.what: UGWP orographic and non-stationary gravity-wave ports
ugwp.alternative: Use the default ArWen physics route or a permissive MPAS drag selection.
